microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: Availability
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The percentage of availability for the storage service or the specified API operation. Availability is calculated by taking the TotalBillableRequests value and dividing it by the number of applicable requests, including those that produced unexpected errors. All unexpected errors result in reduced availability for the storage service or the specified API operation.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: Throttling
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The storage account will be throttled if throughput exceeds the account's tier limit. Increasing the file share or storage tier may be necessary.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: QueueCount
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The number of queues in the storage account.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: FileShareCount
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The number of file shares in the storage account. Currently, alert is set to 0 threshold so it will alert if customer has non-zero file shares in a storage account. Adjust the threshold value to suitable upper limit.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: UsedCapacity
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The amount of storage used by the storage account. For standard storage accounts, it's the sum of capacity used by blob, table, file, and queue. For premium storage accounts and Blob storage accounts, it is the same as BlobCapacity or FileCapacity.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: Egress
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The amount of egress data. This number includes egress to external client from Azure Storage as well as egress within Azure. As a result, this number does not reflect billable egress.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: Ingress
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The amount of ingress data, in bytes. This number includes ingress from an external client into Azure Storage as well as ingress within Azure.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: blobServices - BlobCapacity
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The amount of storage used by the storage account's Blob service in bytes.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: blobServices - SuccessE2ELatency
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The average end-to-end latency of successful requests made to a storage service or the specified API operation, in milliseconds. This value includes the required processing time within Azure Storage to read the request, send the response, and receive acknowledgment of the response.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: blobServices - SuccessServerLatency
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The average time used to process a successful request by Azure Storage. This value does not include the network latency specified in SuccessE2ELatency.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: queueServices - QueueMessageCount
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The number of unexpired queue messages in the storage account.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: queueServices - QueueCapacity
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The amount of Queue storage used by the storage account.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: fileServices - FileCapacity
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The amount of File storage used by the storage account.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: fileServices - Transactions
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The number of requests made to a storage service or the specified API operation. This number includes successful and failed requests, as well as requests which produced errors. Use ResponseType dimension for the number of different type of response.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: fileServices - FileShareSnapshotCount
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The number of snapshots present on the share in storage account's Files Service.

microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.name: fileServices - Availability
microsoft.storage/storageaccounts.description: The percentage of availability for the storage service or the specified API operation. Availability is calculated by taking the TotalBillableRequests value and dividing it by the number of applicable requests, including those that produced unexpected errors. All unexpected errors result in reduced availability for the storage service or the specified API operation.
